title: This will make creative content so much easier #shorts
description:
This is gonna make creative content so much easier to make.

What you’re looking at is the all new AI Studio from Artlist.

Now AI Studio is different because it prioritizes you as a Creative Director over anything else.

The platform works in two parts…Framing and Directing.

First, you build a frame of the exact scene you want to generate.

But rather than get caught up in complex prompting, this platform helps you build out characters and sets that work as tags in your frame description.

You can choose from shot angles, lighting conditions, cameras, lenses and easily swap any component in or out.

The interface feels more like using legos to build your unique world and less like overly difficult prompting from scratch.

Now once you lock in a static frame that you like, you can then switch to Director mode to bring it to life exactly as you envision.

And of course, you can choose from any camera motion, aspect ratios, video models, all of the tweaks you’d want to make on the video side.

If you think about it, this is much closer to the natural way most of us think about video creative.

We can imagine various scenes and then visualize how those scenes should move.

AI Studio is built specifically for that type of workflow.

To me, we have officially entered The Director Era for AI creative content.

The models have gotten so good that output quality is no longer the limiting factor.

The limiting factor is being able to get what you want out of them, and this new AI Studio from Artlist is the most enjoyable creative process for doing that.
